ja348:1.1: Araññā gāmam āgamma kiṃsīlaṃ kiṃvataṃ ahaṃ purisaṃ tāta seveyyaṃ, tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja348:2.1: Yo taṃ vissāsaye tāta vissāsañ ca khameyya te sussūsī ca titikkhī ca taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
ja348:3.1: Yassa kāyena vācāya manasā n' atthi dukkataṃ urasīva patiṭṭhāya taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
ja348:4.1: Haliddirāgaṃ kapicittaṃ purisaṃ rāgavirāginaṃ tādisaṃ tāta mā sevi nimmanussam pi ce siyā ti.
